thread:
deploy-bot: Preflight report for Change Window 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 3% -> 10% -> 30%. Observability snapshot: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/ghi789. Gates: p99 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.4%. Automated smoke checks running. :mag:

morgan: Noticing p99 for seq-gen (us-central canary) at ~415ms right now, baseline ~290ms. Small cluster of 503s around +4m.

diego: 503s correlate with cache-layer logs showing a burst of invalidations: `invalidate key=*model:v2*` — looks like a scheduled job misfire.

anya: That would explain sudden KV misses and p99 inflation. Can we throttle that job?

diego: I'll patch the cronjob to Forbid concurrency: `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob cache-invalidate -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}'`. Doing it now.

morgan: Kicked a cache prewarm on the canary: `POST https://ops-api/warm?svc=seq-gen&percent=3` — warming in progress.

release-coordinator: Reminder: auto-pause on p99 > 350ms for 3m or error_rate > 0.5% for 3m. Manual hold permissible by release lead.

ton y: Preparing pin command in case: `deployctl pin --service seq-gen --version seq-gen:2026-03-19-stable --reason "invalidation storm"`. Will not execute without two approvals.

diego: Host-12 shows disk pressure earlier, which concentrated 503s there. I'll cordon + drain host-12: `kubectl cordon host-12 && kubectl drain host-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

morgan: After rate-limit + cordon, p99 dropped to ~320ms and error_rate at 0.28% (10m window). Improvement but still above gate for a short window.

anya: Propose hold ramp at 3% until p99 < 330ms for 5m and no 5xx spikes. If stable, resume 3% -> 7% -> 15% -> 30% with 3m checks.

release-coordinator: Agreed. Action items: diego -> confirm cronjob patch + drain done; anya -> keep warm script running; morgan -> monitor traces and 5xxs; tony -> standby for pin execute.

ton y: Acknowledged. I'll keep the pin staged but won't execute unless release-lead + oncall approve.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused by manual gate per release-lead request. Snapshot link with traces: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/ghi789?trace=t-2209. To execute pin reply `@deploy-bot execute pin` (requires two approvals).

morgan: Monitoring shows host-12 drain finished, new replicas scheduled. p99 now ~305ms, error_rate 0.22% (10m).

diego: Confirmed cronjob concurrency policy updated. No further invalidation bursts in logs.

release-coordinator: After 5m stable watch, we're clear to resume the staged ramp. If regressions occur, we'll execute the prepared pin. I'll update release notes: add bullet about transient cache invalidation and mitigation.

morgan: Thanks — will keep a close eye on p99 and 5xx.

anya: Warm continues; running additional prewarm to reduce tail latency.

ton y: Standing by for approvals.

release-coordinator: Resuming ramp in staged steps. Reopen thread if we need to pause/rollback. :white_check_mark:
